Applicant :- Tarun Bharadwaj 
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Rakesh Kuamr Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J. 
1.

This application under Section 529 Bnss has been filed with a prayer to direct the court
concerned to decide the Sessions Trial No. 833 of 2021 in case crime no. 1662 of 2024 under
Sections 376, 452, 504 and 506 I.P.C., Police Station- Kavi Nagar, District- Ghaziabad pending in
the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge, F.T.C., First, Ghaziabad expeditiously within
stipulated period.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the said criminal case is pending since 2020 and the matter is pending at the stage of prosecution evidence for long.
The Court concerned is not taking proper interest in disposal of the said case.
5. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.

Tarun Bharadwaj vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16611152/

sentences.text: In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to make all endeavours to decide the aforesaid case expeditiously preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it keeping in view the work load of that Court and also the cooperation rendered by the applicant of this case.

7. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
8. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
